targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "seq")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 10.0}))

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_queue")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "messages_ready" or r._field == "messages_unack")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.queue == "telemetry.q" or r.queue == "dlq")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_node" and r._field == "mem_used")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Connection Count (stats-interval lag ~5s)
panels.description: Backed by RabbitMQ stats interval (~5s), scraped every 10s. Under heavy churn, count may lag true value.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
